rules.activation: completed close >= original entry + 1R; new stop effective next session
rules.close_trail_8pct_after_1r: stop raised to 92% of highest completed close
rules.common: original fixed 2R target; 40 sessions; gap-aware; stop-first

interpretation: The 8% completed-close trail is the stronger 2026 challenger, but the absolute edge remains small and requires 2025 and development-period confirmation before any production change.
drawdown_note: Portfolio maximum drawdown is not reported because these events overlap and no portfolio sizing/capital allocation rule is frozen. Sequential compounding of overlapping trades is invalid.
